Unterwachingen

Unterwachingen is a municipality located in the state of Baden-Württemberg, Germany. Membership in Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm (KIRU)

Unterwachingen is a member of Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm (KIRU), a company that provides information technology services to municipalities in the region. Evidence of this membership can be found on the KIRU website, which lists Unterwachingen as one of its member municipalities. [1] Additionally, the municipality's own website mentions its membership in KIRU, stating that it has been a member since 1992. [2]

KIRU provides a range of services to its member municipalities, including IT consulting, software development, and data processing. As a member of KIRU, Unterwachingen is able to take advantage of these services to support its administrative and technical operations. References:

[2] Gemeinde Unterwachingen. (n.d.). KIRU - Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm.
